subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should an ordinary assistant request timeout spend one bounded retry on the same model and auth profile before OpenClaw rotates the profile or advances configured model fallback?
rationale: Both outcomes are coherent: the retry avoids reacting to a transient timeout as an auth-profile failure, while the current behavior minimizes user-visible timeout latency and reaches configured fallback sooner.

options.title: Adopt bounded same-profile retry
options.body: Accept one additional ordinary timeout window before existing rotation or fallback, preserving the PR's distinct handling for rate limits, auth failures, compaction, and tool execution.

options.title: Keep immediate failover
options.body: Retain the current first-timeout profile-rotation or fallback policy and close or narrow this PR to a separately justified transcript-only repair.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded same-profile retry
recommendation.body: Accept one additional ordinary timeout window before existing rotation or fallback, preserving the PR's distinct handling for rate limits, auth failures, compaction, and tool execution.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged timeout-failover work is the closest established policy boundary for choosing the default assistant-timeout behavior.
